title: Give child tasks hierarchical ids under their parent (needs format 3)
notes: Epic, task and sub-task readable at a glance; parent already exists.

2026-11-22: ids are t-<uuid> in format 2, so hierarchical ids are a format change (format 3). Binaries from the release after 0.2.0 on refuse a newer todo/tadu.json; 0.2.0 and older still misread one, so a bump needs that release widely installed first. The parent field already links the levels.

2026-11-24 audit: not done. No hierarchical-id code or spec text (grep hierarch in spec/tadu/docs/README empty); TASK_FORMAT_VERSION still 2, ids still t-<uuid>; latest tag v0.2.0. Needs format 3 plus a release with the newer-format refusal widely installed first. Smallest next step: draft the format 3 id proposal in spec/ once the post-0.2.0 release is out; keep later.
